brief: Using only the files under docs/ in this repository, answer: in which fetchkit version did the default of Client.retry change from 3 to 5, in which version could it first be set through an environment variable, and what is that variable? Write RESEARCH.json in the repository root with the keys "default_changed_in" and "configurable_in" (version numbers such as "1.0"), "variable", and "sources" (the paths of the files that state these facts).
